comment: Usage distribution by urban and rural area bears on RI-TEC-013 (rural obstacles); other usage metrics such as MDA-CSO-2024-001-0009 and MDA-GOV-2025-003-0026 were mapped there.
Objective 2 is expressly connectivity and digital infrastructure; similar connectivity items (MDA-EU-2024-002-0004) were kept under RI-TEC-014.
scope_basis is chapter (02), which section 5 treats as in scope; better auto with no issue plus a pass 1 query on the chapter tag.
Government-wide ICT governance of state information systems, like the Court of Accounts documentation cluster mapped to RI-TEC-002.
Rating of recommendation 7.6; if -0089 goes to RI-TEC-002, this follows.
Gaps in ICT rules definitions are the same kind of methodological framework gap mapped to RI-TEC-002 with MEC-02 elsewhere in this audit.
The law on the regime of foreigners also governs EU citizens work permits (cf. MDA-EU-2023-001-0050 under RI-FMW-002); could go to RI-FMW-002.
Digitalising authorisation procedures and interoperability of public services are the subject, not IT sector support; should be RI-TEC-037 (with RI-TEC-028), as MDA-GOV-2026-014-0011.
Lack of provisions to attract immigrant workers is a barrier to labour market access of third-country workers; RI-FMW-014 could fit, though admission policy under G4-D03 is defensible.
